passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: I am a student, and I wear a uniform.
phrases.py: wǒ shì xué shēng， wǒ chuān xiào fú。
wǒ zài kè shàng tīng jiǎng。

phrases.en: I ask when I do not know.
phrases.py: wǒ bù dǒng de shí hòu jiù wèn。

phrases.en: I try my best, and I come on time.
phrases.zh: 我尽自己最大的努力，也按时到。
phrases.py: wǒ jǐn zì jǐ zuì dà de nǔ lì， yě àn shí dào。
néng xué xí， wǒ gǎn dào jiāo ào。

phrases.en: A student in the sixth grade has more homework.
phrases.zh: 六年级的学生作业更多。
phrases.py: liù nián jí de xué shēng zuò yè gèng duō。

phrases.en: I listen first, and then I ask.
phrases.py: wǒ xiān tīng， rán hòu zài wèn。

phrases.en: On time is a simple rule, and I keep it.
phrases.ko: 제시간에 오는 것은 간단한 규칙이고, 나는 지켜요.
phrases.zh: 按时到是一条简单的规则，我遵守它。
phrases.py: àn shí dào shì yī tiáo jiǎn dān de guī zé， wǒ zūn shǒu tā。

phrases.en: I try my best because I want to be proud of my work.
phrases.ko: 나는 내 일이 자랑스럽고 싶어서 최선을 다해요.
phrases.zh: 我想为自己的努力骄傲，所以我尽最大的努力。
phrases.py: wǒ xiǎng wèi zì jǐ de nǔ lì jiāo ào， suǒ yǐ wǒ jǐn zuì dà de nǔ lì。

full_passage_lines.en: I am a student, and I wear a uniform.
I ask when I do not know.
I try my best, and I come on time.
A student in the sixth grade has more homework.
I listen first, and then I ask.
On time is a simple rule, and I keep it.
full_passage_lines.ko: 제시간에 오는 것은 간단한 규칙이고, 나는 지켜요.

full_passage_lines.en: I try my best because I want to be proud of my work.
full_passage_lines.ko: 나는 내 일이 자랑스럽고 싶어서 최선을 다해요.

full_passage_spoken: I am a student, and I wear a uniform. I do my homework. I listen in class. I ask when I do not know. I try my best, and I come on time. I follow the rule. I am proud to learn. A student in the sixth grade has more homework. I listen first, and then I ask. On time is a simple rule, and I keep it. I try my best because I want to be proud of my work.
full_passage_zh: 我是学生，我穿校服。我做作业。我在课上听讲。我不懂的时候就问。我尽自己最大的努力，也按时到。我遵守规则。能学习，我感到骄傲。六年级的学生作业更多。我先听，然后再问。按时到是一条简单的规则，我遵守它。我想为自己的努力骄傲，所以我尽最大的努力。
full_passage_pinyin: wǒ shì xué shēng， wǒ chuān xiào fú。 wǒ zuò zuò yè。 wǒ zài kè shàng tīng jiǎng。 wǒ bù dǒng de shí hòu jiù wèn。 wǒ jǐn zì jǐ zuì dà de nǔ lì， yě àn shí dào。 wǒ zūn shǒu guī zé。 néng xué xí， wǒ gǎn dào jiāo ào。 liù nián jí de xué shēng zuò yè gèng duō。 wǒ xiān tīng， rán hòu zài wèn。 àn shí dào shì yī tiáo jiǎn dān de guī zé， wǒ zūn shǒu tā。 wǒ xiǎng wèi zì jǐ de nǔ lì jiāo ào， suǒ yǐ wǒ jǐn zuì dà de nǔ lì。
